ops.title: metal-off-tailnet incident (2026-07-03) — install-system-daemon kills tailscaled at every activation, single-use authkeys, kcpassword lockouts, and the offline disk-mount recovery playbook
ops.body:
metal dropped off the tailnet at a `metal-redeploy` switch and stayed off across reboots.
Three stacked causes, all now fixed in-repo:

1. **`tailscaled install-system-daemon` ran on EVERY activation** and terminates a running
   tailscaled whose re-load silently fails on the Tahoe base (`>/dev/null 2>&1 || true` hid it;
   the daemon log ends at "got signal terminated"). Clean boots always healed it via RunAtLoad,
   masking it for weeks. Fixed: guarded to first-install-only in darwin/metal.nix postActivation.
2. **Authkeys are single-use, 24 h** (`_ts_mint_key`: `reusable: False`, 86400 s). Once the
   daemon lost its state/session, the cold-join branch re-ran `tailscale up --authkey` with a
   CONSUMED key → logged out forever. Recovery: mint fresh key via the keychain OAuth client,
   surgically swap `tailscale.authkey` in the host-side sops bundle (decrypt with
   `~/.yclaw/state/hosts/<host>/key.txt`, python-swap, re-encrypt `--age $(age-keygen -y key)`),
   `nuke-tailnet.sh metal` (else MagicDNS drifts to metal-1), then re-join.
3. **Re-join trigger on a sentinel'd VM**: nothing re-runs `tailscale up` on a normal reboot.
   Deleting `/var/lib/metal-activated` re-runs the packer activator at next boot — but it
   activates the BAKED (old) toplevel via `nix-env --set`, so `just redeploy metal` afterwards.

**Offline recovery playbook (no SSH path — metal has no OpenSSH):** stop the VM
(`launchctl bootout gui/$UID/com.yclaw.tart-metal; tart stop metal` — the disk is exclusively
locked while running), then `hdiutil attach -imagekey diskimage-class=CRawDiskImage -nomount
~/.tart/vms/metal/disk.img` → `diskutil mount [readOnly] <Data slice>` → read
`/Volumes/Data/private/var/log/metal-activate.log`, `Library/Tailscale/tailscaled.log1.txt`
(state = `Library/Tailscale/tailscaled.state`), fix files, detach, re-bootstrap the runner.
VNC console: `tart run metal --vnc-experimental` prints a `vnc://` URL; grab frames with
`uvx --from vncdotool vncdo -s 127.0.0.1::PORT -p PASS capture out.png` (host `screencapture`
is black when the display is locked). AVOID typing login passwords blind: failed attempts
(including every boot's stale-kcpassword auto-login) accrue macOS account lockouts with
escalating timers. The stale 12-byte `/etc/kcpassword` predates the password rotation;
packer's reset-admin-password now disables auto-login instead.

Probe gotcha: `tailscale ping <name>` gives false negatives against a freshly re-created node
(stale MagicDNS view) — check `tailscale status --json` peer `Online` instead (yclaw status
does). Related: [[metal-reboot-survival]], [[tailscale-seed-key-and-vm-recovery]],
[[deploy-pipeline-fixes-2026-06]].
